lines.l: To be near you, to be free
I am flying, I am flying
Like a bird across the sky
I am flying, passing high clouds
To hear you, to be free
Can you hear me, can you help me
Can you hear me through the dark night, far away?
I am dying, forever crying to be with you who can say.
We are sailing, we are sailing, home again, across the sea, we are sailing, so you are, we hear you, to be free,
